status: candidate, never applied to a camera. The old bytes are verified against the extracted firmware; nothing else is.
purpose: Stop centring the short readout window in the sensor. The offset is 366 and (4672 - 3942) / 2 = 365, so it exists to centre the 16:9 window; with a full-height window it has to be 0.
reference: Mirrors the A7 IV kit's S7 (LC table V offset 366 -> 0) and S8 (LC field 403 -> 19) at this camera's own addresses. Apply it together with og_window_fullheight_v0, not instead of it.
